Online Check-in on the Web and App

Check in conveniently online or use the ITA Airways app, available for iOS in the App Store and for Android on Google Play.

Online Check-in in Three Easy Steps
  1. Enter your booking details: select your flight and any passengers traveling with you
  2. Choose additional services: seat selection with a charge based on your fare class and checked baggage
  3. Choose how to receive your boarding pass

If you need to check in baggage, you can skip the lines with the dedicated drop-off desks at the airport (where available) or the Business Class desks.
Please note: check-in for unaccompanied minors and passengers requiring dedicated assistance must be completed at the airport to ensure proper support.

Check-in Opening Times

This service is available starting 48 hours before your flight's departure, even if you have checked baggage.

Exceptions to online check-in opening times:

  • Passengers traveling to the US must arrive at check-in desks 3.5 hours before departure for mandatory document checks. Please have your ESTA, Green Card, or Visa ready.

Please note: For flights to/from Brazil, Argentina, Japan, and the United States, you must enter your passport information. For flights to London and Cairo, you must enter your passport or identity card information.

Latest Check-in Times
Please note that you can check in and obtain your boarding pass up to one hour before departure for international flights and up to 40 minutes before departure for domestic flights.
Additional Services

Prefer a window seat or the front row? Choose your seat during online check-in.

Looking to travel with more baggage than your ticket allows? Purchase Extra Baggage.

Passengers with disabilities or reduced mobility can receive the same discount by calling the dedicated number. Please ensure assistance is requested no later than the day before your flight departure.

Who Can Check In Online?

Online check-in, via the web and mobile app, is available to all passengers traveling on flights operated by ITA Airways, except:

  • Passengers traveling on flights not operated by ITA Airways
  • Passengers departing from: TiranaLampedusaPantelleriaAlicante
Collect Your Boarding Pass

You can choose how to collect/print your boarding pass:

  • ITA Airways app or ita-airways.com*
  • Check-in counters

When boarding, please be ready to show your boarding pass on your mobile device. Please print a paper backup only when necessary, using the airport check-in counters.

*Boarding passes for the following flights must be collected at the airport (online printing is not possible): Accra, Algiers, Cairo, Dakar, Malé, Tripoli, Tunis.
For flights to/from the USA, boarding passes can be printed 24 hours before the flight's departure.

How To Check In Your Baggage

You can still check in online if you have baggage to drop off. After completing online check-in, leave your baggage at the designated 'Drop-off' desks in major airports, or at the Business Class desks in other airports. Need more baggage than your ticket permits? You can purchase extra allowance online while completing the check-in process. For more details, see Baggage to check in.

*Please note: this service is not available for passengers with same-day connecting flights not operated by ITA Airways, or for flights departing from Tirana, Pantelleria, Lampedusa, Palma de Mallorca, Menorca, Split, and Ibiza.

Choose Your Favorite Seat in All Travel Classes

During check-in, you can choose your preferred seat. This option is available for a small fee, depending on your ticket's fare class.
